s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with chronic abdominal pain and vomiting, featuring a tender abdominal mass
salient_findings: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus
Diffuse lymphadenopathy and mesenteric mass on CT
key_facts: Normal passage of stool and flatus
Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus
Low bicarbonate, low PCO2, marginally acidotic pH on venous blood gas
No evidence of infection on urinalysis and blood cultures
CT Abdomen findings: Diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass
Mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine and encasing the mesenteric vasculature

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass on CT Abdomen

shortlist.label: Mesenteric panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic abdominal pain and a tender mass near the umbilicus

shortlist.label: Sclerosing mesenteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine and encasing the mesenteric vasculature

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus and elevated lactate levels

shortlist.label: Desmoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large mesenteric mass and chronic abdominal pain

raw.rationale: The presence of diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass on CT abdomen, along with the patient's symptoms of nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain, are highly suggestive of lymphoma. The elevated lactate levels and acidotic pH also indicate possible bowel ischemia or obstruction, which can be caused by the mesenteric mass encasing the mesenteric vasculature, a common feature in lymphoma.

rejected.label: Mesenteric panniculitis
rejected.why: While mesenteric panniculitis can cause abdominal pain and a mass, it typically does not cause diffuse lymphadenopathy or significantly elevated lactate levels.

rejected.label: Sclerosing mesenteritis
rejected.why: Sclerosing mesenteritis can cause abdominal pain and a mass, but it usually does not present with lymphadenopathy or the degree of lactate elevation seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: Gastrointestinal stromal tumors can cause a mass and abdominal pain, but they are typically solitary and do not cause diffuse lymphadenopathy.

rejected.label: Desmoid tumor
rejected.why: Desmoid tumors can cause a mass and abdominal pain, but they are usually solitary, do not cause lymphadenopathy, and are not typically associated with the degree of lactate elevation seen in this patient.
